PROBLEM: Autonomous aircraft cannot establish at runtime whether the assumptions under which an autonomy function (controller, planner, estimator) was verified remain true.
WHO_HAS_IT: Any operator of verified autonomy functions; UAS under ASTM F3269; ML-enabled functions under EASA/FAA guidance.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: A verified guarantee is only as good as its assumptions; incidents show assumptions failing without component failure (R060, R061, R062, R064).
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Assumption monitors for assume-guarantee contracts (R019); calibrated confidence composition over verification assumptions (R020); runtime model-compliance monitors with fail-safe (R021); requirement-to-monitor toolchains on cFS/ROS2 (R022); weakly-hard timing monitors (R023); perception contracts (R024); ODD monitors (R028); UL 4600 SPIs (R015).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: As a general capability nothing essential is missing in the searched sources. What remains are assumptions that are not directly observable: latent capability quantities (authority, power available, recoverability) and navigation-error bounds; these are carried into G02, G07 and G08.
EVIDENCE_GAP_IS_REAL: Incidents are real (R060-R065) but the monitoring capability is established.
COMMERCIAL_VALUE: LOW as a separate product; value sits in G02/G07/G08.

PROBLEM: Electric rotorcraft (multirotor UAS and eVTOL) cannot determine before actuator or power saturation whether several individually acceptable degradations (battery power capability under state of charge, temperature and ageing; propulsor/ESC derating or damage; wind and payload demand) together leave enough control authority and power for the current and planned flight states.
WHO_HAS_IT: Delivery-drone operators, eVTOL developers (continued safe flight and landing), inspection/ISR multirotors, planetary rotorcraft.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Combined-margin loss is the classic rotorcraft accident pattern (R066) and a major loss-of-control pattern (R039); eVTOL batteries can shut down under sustained high power at low SOC (R044); certification requires performance after failure combinations (R053); fielded autopilots detect thrust loss only after saturation (R084).
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Rotor-degradation controllability index ACAI (R033); guaranteed reachable sets and viability under diminished control authority (R034, R035); safe flight envelope estimation for impaired aircraft (R032); NASA ICM dynamic vehicle assessment (R036); envelope-aware FMS (R037); battery power-capability assessment for eVTOL landing and dynamic reserves (R043); battery-aware predictive planning and control for multirotors (R042); rotorcraft thrust-margin monitoring patent (R045); PX4 energy-time check (R081, R082).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: In the searched sources each method covers one or two degradation channels, or plans around them without producing an assurance-grade margin; no directly matching work was identified that composes electrical power capability, propulsor degradation and aerodynamic/wind demand into a conservative runtime margin, evaluated before saturation, against the demand of the current and planned flight states. Fielded open-source autopilots use per-factor fixed thresholds (R080, R083), energy-time comparison (R081) and post-saturation thrust-loss inference (R084).
EVIDENCE_GAP_IS_REAL: Helicopter accidents from combined density altitude, weight and wind (R066); LOC combinations (R039); eVTOL battery shutdown risk (R044); MEL rule against hazardous combinations of deferred items (R054); SC-VTOL combination requirement (R053); fielded reactive checks (R080-R084, V4).
IMPLEMENTATION_DIFFICULTY: MEDIUM-HIGH: coupled nonlinear battery-propulsor-aerodynamic models with conservative bounds; battery physics absent from the SWORT SITL apparatus (R090).
COMMERCIAL_VALUE: HIGH: delivery drones and eVTOL need it for continued safe flight and landing and contingency decisions (R053, R045, R043).
RESEARCH_VALUE: MEDIUM: composition with guarantees under coupled uncertainty; theory exists for pieces (R034, R035).

PROBLEM: Component health estimates are not translated into explicit vehicle capability bounds (maximum safe bank angle, climb margin, hover guarantee, route feasibility) that constrain autonomous actions.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Health data that cannot constrain actions does not protect the mission.
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Envelope-aware FMS with envelope estimation and LOC override (R037); emergency landing planner and adaptive flight planning (R038); safe flight envelope estimation (R032); NASA ICM capability assessment feeding mission management (R036); health-aware planning (R041); PX4 energy-time RTL check (R081, R082); ACAI (R033).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: The mapping itself is established; the residual is the capability estimate under compound degradation for electric rotorcraft, which is G02.
EVIDENCE_GAP_IS_REAL: Real (R036 frames it as an open UAM challenge) but it duplicates G02 once the estimate exists.

PROBLEM: Autonomous aircraft cannot state at runtime that a safety guarantee holds because assumptions A1..An are supported by current evidence E1..Em, and update that statement.
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: ConSerts (R010); dynamic safety cases (R011); dynamic assurance cases with an autonomous taxiing UAS (R012); ENTRUST (R013); ReSonAte (R014); SPIs (R015, R016); Assurance 2.0 defeaters (R017); runtime confidence updates (R018); CoCo (R020).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: Nothing essential in the searched sources; the residual is the physical evidence feeding the argument, which is G02/G08.
EVIDENCE_GAP_IS_REAL: The need is documented (R011, R016) and served.

PROBLEM: Autonomy does not track whether operation remains inside the region for which certification or V&V evidence is valid.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Evidence outside its region is not evidence.
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: ODD specification and exit (R029); EASA ODD-centred guidance with runtime monitoring (R027); ODD-to-RTLola monitors for aviation (R028); verified-region runtime assurance for NN taxiing (R030); SPIs (R015).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: Nothing beyond naming: this is ODD monitoring.

PROBLEM: Fault diagnosis outputs, especially ambiguous ones, are not connected rigorously to safe-action selection.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Acting on an unresolved diagnosis is unsafe.
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Covered by the earlier CSIA-DX review (active FTC, belief-space planning, safe active diagnosis).

PROBLEM: Runtime-assurance architectures verify their recovery function and switching boundary offline against a nominal vehicle model; after degradation, the searched fielded and standard material does not show the architecture establishing at runtime that recovery is still achievable.
WHO_HAS_IT: UAS applicants using ASTM F3269; eVTOL RTA designs; RTA for learning-enabled functions.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: If the recovery function can no longer recover, the whole runtime-assurance argument fails silently (R003, R008).
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: L1Simplex for physical failures (R002); adaptive and provably correct Simplex (R004); emergency-brake Simplex for abrupt reachability changes (R004); conformal recovery-deadline certificates for adapting controllers (R004); backup CBFs with online forward integration (R005); online reachable sets under diminished authority (R034); real-time reachability for Simplex (R009).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: The adaptive methods need a current degradation model or bound; the searched sources do not show that bound being established at runtime from vehicle evidence before the recovery is needed, and the standard (R001) was not read (UNCLEAR).
EVIDENCE_GAP_IS_REAL: Model error invalidates Simplex guarantees (R003, attribution UNCLEAR); fallback not always capable (R008); no aircraft incident attributed to it was found.

PROBLEM: Autonomous aircraft and landers that rely on vision, lidar or terrain-relative navigation cannot bound navigation error with integrity (protection levels at a stated integrity risk), so estimator-quality assumptions fail silently when terrain, lighting or weather departs from the design case.
WHO_HAS_IT: Planetary rotorcraft and landers; UAM vertiport operations; delivery drones in GNSS-degraded or weather conditions.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Recent losses: Ingenuity flight 72 (R060), Hakuto-R M1 and M2 (R061), IM-1 and IM-2 (R065), Amazon MK30 (R062).
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: GNSS RAIM/ARAIM-style integrity (earlier package); vision/VIO integrity monitoring research (R070, R071); perception contracts (R024); redundancy by more sensors (R065).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: Per R070, algorithm integrity remains a main certification challenge for visual navigation, with scenario-dependent fault frequency and magnitude; approaches focus on accuracy rather than integrity.
EVIDENCE_GAP_IS_REAL: Five total or partial losses at four organizations in 2023-2025 attributed to navigation or altitude sensing (R060-R062, R065); the NAVIGATION review (R070).
NOVELTY_CROWDING: HIGH: GNSS-integrity, vision and ML-perception communities.
IMPLEMENTATION_DIFFICULTY: HIGH: scene-dependent fault models, integrity risk budgets.

PROBLEM: Redundancy assumptions (independent failures) become false at runtime through common-mode conditions.
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Analytical redundancy detecting common-mode failures (R073); design-time common-cause analysis.

PROBLEM: Timing, latency or computation assumptions behind control guarantees become false at runtime.
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Weakly-hard (m,k) runtime monitors switching to safe mode (R023); requirement-derived hard-real-time monitors (R022).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: Nothing essential in the searched sources.

PROBLEM: Mass, CG or configuration changes (payload pick-up/drop, accretion) invalidate the envelope the autonomy assumes.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Configuration change drove the Helios loss at design time (R063).
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Online mass/inertia estimation and adaptive control (R074); Helios lesson concerns design-time analysis methods (R063).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: Runtime estimation is established; the residual (how the changed parameters reduce margin) is G02.
EVIDENCE_GAP_IS_REAL: Real at design time (R063); runtime part addressed.

PROBLEM: When the assumptions behind autonomy fail, autonomy hands a degraded situation to a human (on board or remote) whose response assumptions may also be false.
WHO_HAS_IT: Transport aircraft automation; remote-pilot UAS operations.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Pilot-response assumptions in safety assessment did not hold for MCAS (R064); remote supervision interfered with MQ-9 recovery (R067).
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Revision of pilot-response assumptions in certification (R064); human-AI teaming guidance (R027); RTA with human primary (R006).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: Runtime assurance that a human will respond as assumed is not shown in the searched sources; the field is largely human factors.

PROBLEM: Autonomy cannot continuously guarantee that at least one safe contingency (return, divert, land) remains feasible given current health, energy and environment.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Losing the last feasible option is how degraded flights end in the field (R067).
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Emergency landing planner and adaptive flight planning (R038); envelope-aware FMS (R037); energy-constrained multicopter emergency planning (R046); PX4 RTL-time versus battery-time failsafe (R081, R082); dynamic eVTOL reserves (R043).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: The planning layer exists; the residual is the degraded-capability estimate feeding it (G02).
EVIDENCE_GAP_IS_REAL: Real; addressed by planning given an estimate.

PROBLEM: Assumed failure rates and hazard frequencies in the safety assessment drift from reality over the fleet life.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: The safety case rests on those numbers.
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: ARP5150 in-service safety assessment (R058); UL 4600 SPIs (R015); IASMS (R055).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: Nothing essential in the searched sources.

PROBLEM: Adaptive or learning controllers that change in flight cannot be assured once they have adapted.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Adaptation can degrade the original safety profile (R031).
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Runtime assurance wrapping adaptive controllers (R002, R030); L1-adaptive high-assurance controllers (R002).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: The FAA roadmap scopes learned (static) AI first and learning AI later (R031), so the in-flight learning case is not a near-term certification target.

PROBLEM: Components of an autonomy stack are each verified under assumptions about the others, and those cross-assumptions can become inconsistent at runtime.
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: Assume-guarantee contract composition (R025); monitoring contract assumptions (R019); confidence composition (R020).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: Nothing essential in the searched sources.

PROBLEM: A single environmental factor (e.g. wind) exceeds the bound under which the autonomy was verified.
CURRENT_SOLUTIONS: PX4 wind-limit failsafe on the wind estimate with configurable action (R080, V4); wind-aware return-time estimate (R082, V4).
WHAT_THEY_STILL_CANNOT_DO: Nothing essential for a single factor; the composition of factors is G02.
